tools.name: account_information
tools.description: Get the business details for the connected user, e.g. business name, type, address, year end date, vat status and account size statistics.

tools.name: invoices_list
tools.description: Search for invoices and estimates using a specific set of search parameters

order_column.description: Ordering of the results by specified column. Defaults to issue_date if omitted.

order_direction.description: Order direction (Ascending or Descending). Defaults to desc if omitted'.

type.description: Document type e.g. invoices, estimates or recurring invoice templates

status.description: Invoice status (e.g., draft, sent, paidpart, paidfull, active, unpaid, deleted, aged). Estimate status e.g. (disputed, agreed, declined). Recurring invoice status e.g. (paused, active). Note: to extract outstanding invoices use the status 'unpaid', this will include sent and paidpart invoices.

tools.name: invoices_get
tools.description: Retrieve a single invoice or estimate by its ID

id.description: The unique ID of the invoice or estimate to retrieve

tools.name: clients_get
tools.description: Retrieve client and contact data for a specific client ID

id.description: The unique ID of the client to retrieve

contacts.description: Returns a list of client contacts associated with this record.

financials.description: Returns credits on account and balance info.

tools.name: clients_list
tools.description: Retrieve client records based on a set of search parameters

order_column.description: Which columns should be used for ordering the results. Default is company_name.

order_direction.description: Order direction (Ascending or Descending). Default is 'desc'.

include_deleted.description: Show previously deleted clients. Default is false.

include_total_invoiced.description: Returns the total amount invoiced for each client.

include_total_paid.description: Returns the total payments received for each client.

include_total_credits.description: Returns the total of prepayments held on account for each client.

tools.name: banks_list
tools.description: Retrieve a list of bank accounts matching specified filter parameters

order_column.description: Which columns should be used for ordering the results. Default is account_name.

order_direction.description: Order direction (Ascending or Descending). Default is 'desc'.

include_hidden.description: Include bank accounts that are hidden. Default is false.

include_consents.description: How Open Banking bank feed consents. Default is false.

tools.name: banks_transactions
tools.description: Retrieve a list of transactions for a specific bank account with optional filters

id.description: The unique ID of the bank account to retrieve transactions for.

date_to.description: Filter transactions up to this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

min_amount.description: Filter by a minimum transaction amount.

max_amount.description: Filter by a maximum transaction amount.

search_term.description: Search term to match against description or reference.

order_column.description: Column to order the transactions by. Default is date.

order_direction.description: Order direction (Ascending or Descending). Default is 'desc'.

tag_status.description: Filter transactions by tag status. Can be 'all', 'tagged', or 'untagged'.

tools.name: clients_contacts_get
tools.description: Retrieve a list of contacts associated with a specific client ID

id.description: The unique ID of the client whose contacts you want to retrieve.

tools.name: banks_balance_get
tools.description: Retrieve the balance for a specific bank account ID

id.description: The unique ID of the bank account whose balance you want to retrieve.

tools.name: suppliers_list
tools.description: Retrieve a list of suppliers based on a set of search and sorting parameters

order_column.description: Which columns should be used for ordering the results. Default is company_name.

order_direction.description: Order direction (Ascending or Descending). Default is 'desc'.

include_deleted.description: Show previously deleted suppliers. Default is false.

tools.name: suppliers_get
tools.description: Retrieve detailed data for a specific supplier by ID

id.description: The unique ID of the supplier to retrieve

tools.name: purchases_list
tools.description: Retrieve a list of purchases based on a set of search and sorting parameters

order_column.description: Ordering of the results by specified column. Defaults to issue_date if omitted.

order_direction.description: Order direction (Ascending or Descending). Defaults to desc if omitted.

status.description: Purchase status (e.g. draft, sent, paidpart, paidfull, active, unpaid, deleted, aged). Note: to extract outstanding purchases use the status 'unpaid', this will include sent and paidpart purchases.

tools.name: purchases_get
tools.description: Retrieve detailed data for a specific purchase by ID

id.description: The unique ID of the purchase to retrieve

tools.name: journals_get
tools.description: Retrieve detailed data for a specific journal entry by ID

id.description: The unique string reference ID of the journal to retrieve

tools.name: journals_list
tools.description: Retrieve a list of journals based on a set of search and sorting parameters

date_to.description: Filter journals up to this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

tools.name: ledgers_list
tools.description: Retrieve a list of nominal ledgers (Chart of Accounts). Sales (4000 - 4999), Purchases (5000 - 5999), Direct Expenses (6000 - 6999), Overheads (7000 - 9999).

nominal_code_start.description: The nominal code range from where you would like to start. Default is 1.

nominal_code_end.description: The nominal code range from where you would like to end. Default is 9999.

tools.name: ledgers_transactions
tools.description: Retrieve detailed transaction postings for nominal ledgers

nominal_code.description: Filter transactions by nominal ledger code (must be a number between 1 and 9999).

date_from.description: Filter ledger transactions from this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

date_to.description: Filter ledger transactions up to this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

description.description: Search term to match against entry description.

tools.name: reports_chart_of_accounts
tools.description: Retrieve the Chart of Accounts report based on a set of parameters

nominal_code_start.description: The nominal code range from where you would like to start. Default is 1

nominal_code_end.description: The nominal code range to where you would like to end. Default is 9999

date_from.description: From date (yyyy-mm-dd). Gets the balance of the nominal account from this date.

date_to.description: To date (yyyy-mm-dd). Gets the balance of the nominal account to this date.

exclude_zero_balance_ledgers.description: Excludes any ledgers that hold a zero balance for the given date range. If excluded will assume to be true.

tools.name: reports_balance_sheet
tools.description: Retrieve the Balance Sheet report up to a given date.

date_to.description: The date up to which the balance sheet is calculated (yyyy-mm-dd).

tools.name: reports_profit_and_loss
tools.description: Retrieve the Profit and Loss report for a given date range.

date_from.description: Start date of the reporting period (yyyy-mm-dd).

date_to.description: End date of the reporting period (yyyy-mm-dd).

tools.name: reports_vat_obligations
tools.description: Retrieve VAT obligations from HMRC showing what periods have been fulfilled or are due.

date_from.description: Start date of the obligation period (yyyy-mm-dd).

date_to.description: End date of the obligation period (yyyy-mm-dd).

tools.name: reports_ageing
tools.description: Retrieve debtor or creditor invoice ageing reports

type.description: Type of ageing report (debtor or creditor).

offset.description: Page offset. Zero (0) would show results from the begining of the record set. Offset can be used for paging functions.
